The following steps allow to make use of device tree overlay files, a definition of device tree overlay provided by kernel.org is the next:. "A Devicetree’s overlay purpose is to modify the kernel’s live tree, and have the modification affecting the state of the kernel in a way that is reflecting the changes. Knowing that, in this post will be used as an example the baseboard "i.MX 93 EVK" and will be added with device tree overlay an LVDS panel, adding an automatic detection from u-boot, and will be used a host with linux version Ubuntu 20.04.2. # Linux device-tree overlay from linux-imx. This section explains all about device tree overlay compilation and building, to create a .dtso file, the equivalent of .dts for overlays, adding some difference between them, using as base the linux-imx repository. Using as an example the file imx93-11x11-evk-boe-wxga-lvds-panel.dts located in the previous repository file direction <linux-imx path>/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/ using it as a base tree:.
